definition: to say someone did something wrong
description: A bright, nearly empty room with a wooden floor, a pendant lamp and a tall window onto a spiral fire escape. A young man with curly hair and a beard, in a long navy coat, stands stiffly and points his finger straight at a grey-and-white husky. The dog sits in a huge mess of white stuffing pulled out of a torn mustard-yellow cushion and howls back at him. The man lowers his arm and starts to smile, and the husky lies down on the cushion. A lake painting hangs on the wall.

de.answer: Er zeigt anklagend mit dem Finger auf den Husky.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está señalando al husky con un dedo acusador.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il pointe un doigt accusateur vers le husky.
phrases: être assis au milieu du rembourrage blanc
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
